verdict.rationale: A published public data API is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents API endpoints, a developer key-issuance path, or stated rate limits. The cited pages cover Gateway portal tips, OHID human sign-in and tax-filing services, and the probes show ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov returning 403 at robots.txt. OHID is a user login credential, not API key issuance, so it earns no credit.
